description: Searches Claude Code sessions across all projects by literal, case-insensitive keyword.

evals.name: Find a session by keyword
evals.prompt: Find that session where we discussed the login bug.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py search with a literal keyword and --format json, groups matches by session, shows matching text with context and a resume command.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a memory-content search
evals.prompt: Search my memory files for anything about the login bug.
evals.expected_output: Declines to run its own session-content search and points the user to session-memory-search instead, per its own stated exclusion.
